world.org_type: a regional parcel carrier with six sort hubs and twelve delivery depots

driver: The decisive quantity is each node's share of the units that passed through it unrecorded, when which node an unrecorded unit passed is itself unrecorded: the plan of record assigns every unit a node, but on the nights one node overflowed part of its flow went through a second node and was handled there by hand, so that night's unrecorded units belong partly to each and only the batch a unit was unloaded in at its destination, whose recorded members all passed one node, says which; charged by the plan the overflowing node carries the second node's misses, and charged by the nights' excess over its usual rate the overflowing node sheds the misses its own overload caused.
driver_concrete: Each unscanned parcel's hub is the hub of the trailer it came off at its delivery depot, read from the unloading it was scanned off in at the depot door, whose sorted parcels all carry one hub's sort event; on the nights Pruszkow overflowed, Strykow sorted the overflow on its manual line (9.03 per cent missed) and trucked it to the Warsaw depots on its own trailers, so the sort plan charges Pruszkow with Strykow's misses, the morning's sorted split spreads them as if both hubs missed alike, and the overflow nights' excess read as Strykow's takes from Pruszkow the misses its own sorter made running full.
stump: A competent solver takes each parcel's hub from its sort scan or, where it has none, from the sort plan of its night and fires Sosnowiec and Pruszkow; Strykow sorted Pruszkow's overflow by hand on the heavy nights and sent it to the Warsaw depots on its own trailers, so the unscanned overflow parcels that route charges to Pruszkow came off Strykow's trailers, and only the trailer each unscanned parcel came off at its delivery depot fires Strykow as well.

differentiation.task480: task480 v2 recovers each unit's future yearly amount from one cumulative total observed once, set against the cross-section's cumulative curve by age; here nothing is projected and no curve is fitted: each record missing its stratum takes the stratum of the batch it travelled in, because the missingness depends on the stratum (Strykow's manual line missed six times Pruszkow's rate) and every batch's recorded members carry one stratum

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a count of alerts each unit raises when its departure from an estimate built from its nearest other units passes a limit set from that departure's past spread; when some units leave, the remaining units' estimates come from farther units and their departures spread wider while their limits stay at the spread measured with the old neighbours, so the alerts rise even as the units fall.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-20 at stage 4: reader 1 re-ran the quality control with the 34 closing stations out of the neighbour pool and landed the call (4.0 at 9 a year, every setting within one of the golden 61/25/9/3); reader 2 replayed the record and filed 3.5 at 9; judge DETERMINISTIC APPROVE. The network re-run is now the first rung of architecture 2.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a count of alerts a less sensitive limit will raise, read from a record the current limit produced: every fault the current limit caught was repaired within days, so the record holds those faults cut short below the higher limit they would otherwise have reached, and the count is the record re-run on the units and estimate sources the next period will have plus one alert for every caught fault the re-run never alerted before its repair.
lineage.stump: A competent solver re-runs the quality control on the 2025 to 2027 export with the 131 stations the network keeps and files 3.5 at 23 drift alerts a year, inside the field plan's 28 visits (22 with the cut-short drifts added to the record as it ran, 12 on the record replayed); 30 of the 35 drifts the sensor history shows repaired at kept stations never reached the 3.5 limit before their repair and would have kept growing until they did, which puts 3.5 at 33 and files 4.0 at 18.
